description: Whisper's non-speech markers (issue #1811). One rule for every head: shared-core-rs hw-text strip_whisper_non_speech_markers. A marker is one of BLANK_AUDIO / BLANK AUDIO, silence, no speech, inaudible, music, applause, in [] or (), any case, whitespace allowed inside the brackets. Where a marker is removed, whitespace runs collapse to one space; the result is trimmed; marker-only input is empty. Text with no marker is only trimmed. A bracket the speaker dictated survives. Run by shared-core-rs/crates/hw-text/tests/whisper_marker_vectors.rs, app/shared-dotnet/HyperWhisper.LocalInference.Tests, app/windows/HyperWhisper.SmokeTests and app/macos/hyperwhisperTests/WhisperMarkerConformanceVectorTests.swift.
